description: This file implements the IpcClient class and related functions for managing IPC communication in the Rialto client, including connection setup, disconnection, and thread management.

classes.name: IIpcClientAccessor
classes.description: Interface providing access to the singleton instance of the IPC client accessor.

classes.name: IpcClient
classes.description: Implements the IPC client handling connection, disconnection, and thread management for IPC communication.

methods.name: IIpcClientAccessor::instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the IPC client accessor.

methods.name: IIpcClientAccessor::getIpcClient
methods.description: Returns a reference to the singleton IPC client.

methods.name: IpcClient::IpcClient
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the IPC client and attempts to connect.

methods.name: IpcClient::~IpcClient
methods.description: Destructor that attempts to disconnect the IPC client.

methods.name: IpcClient::connect
methods.description: Establishes an IPC connection based on environment variables and starts the IPC thread.

methods.name: IpcClient::disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the IPC client, joins the IPC thread, and resets the channel.

methods.name: IpcClient::processIpcThread
methods.description: Function run in a separate thread to process IPC events and handle disconnection.

methods.name: IpcClient::getChannel
methods.description: Returns a weak pointer to the current IPC channel.

methods.name: IpcClient::createBlockingClosure
methods.description: Creates a blocking closure, choosing the appropriate method based on the calling thread.

methods.name: IpcClient::createRpcController
methods.description: Creates and returns a new RPC controller.
